definitions.explanation: The process of absorbing into or becoming similar to a surrounding culture, group, or environment. Also used in biology for the metabolic process of converting nutrients into body tissue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{移民|いみん}→移民：05314_imin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{同化|どうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Immigrants assimilate into the local culture.

examples.japanese: {同化|どうか}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少数民族|しょうすうみんぞく}→少数民族：15582_shousuuminzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧しまう⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Assimilation policies risk erasing the culture of ethnic minorities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{同化|どうか}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After living abroad for a long time, I had unknowingly assimilated into the local way of life.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb: {同化|どうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to assimilate). Most commonly appears in discussions of cultural integration, immigration, and social policy. In biology, it refers to anabolism — the process by which organisms convert nutrients into body tissue.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同化|どうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assimilate
- {同化|どうか}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: assimilation policy
- ⟦{文化的|ぶんかてき}→文化的：05688_bunkateki⟧{同化|どうか}: cultural assimilation
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{同化|どうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assimilate into ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
{同化|どうか} implies becoming the same as the surrounding group. ⟦{適応|てきおう}→適応：14382_tekiou⟧ (adaptation) means adjusting to an environment without necessarily losing one's own identity. ⟦{融合|ゆうごう}→融合：14036_yuugou⟧ (fusion) implies mutual blending of both sides.
